build_quantization_weight_pack_pass: build quantization weight pack pass with dequant promotion, qconv weight prepack, and qlinear weight prepack
register_quantization_unary_fusion: register quantization unary fusion patterns for qconv2d and qlinear with relu and hardtanh activations
register_quantization_binary_fusion: register quantization binary fusion patterns for qconv2d with add and relu post-operations
register_dequant_promotion: register dequant promotion pass to clone shared dequant patterns for multiple downstream nodes
register_qconv_weight_prepack: register qconv weight prepack pass to replace conv2d with onednn qconv2d_pointwise and weight prepack nodes
